The absolute-trend gate has validated risk-control value in this market (gate_helps=true), so eligibility is a meaningful de-risking signal, but cross-sectional rank carries no alpha and the track record shows direction accuracy of only 0.316 — leaning low is the honest default.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Pipelines & Midstream (ineligible for scoring but breadth=1.0, durability_bar=0.77, hurst_tag=trend) harvests enough flow from the crowded Oil & Gas leader to displace it as the energy leadership expression — the observable that would retire this watch is Pipelines & Midstream clearly leading Oil & Gas Producers on a rolling 20-day basis, or Oil & Gas breadth falling below 0.7 while Pipelines holds breadth at 1.0.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only other eligible theme with a clean trend-health profile (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.71, breadth 0.857, not crowded) and it is the named challenger to the crowded energy leader. Relative to Oil & Gas, its crowding_z of 0.44 vs the leader's 1.18 makes it a less crowded expression of the prevailing risk-on allocation, and it clears the absolute-trend gate — the one validated drawdown-control leg.
theses.dissent: The momentum gap to the leader is wide (score 2.24 vs 0.847) and financials are tightly tied to the same macro beta as energy — if the broad TSX risk bid stalls, Banks offers no idiosyncratic cushion.
